description.zh: 把 Win顺 的设置备份自动传到 WebDAV（坚果云、NAS 等）或 GitHub 私有仓库，换电脑时输入 cloud 一键恢复
description.en: Keeps Win顺's settings backup on a WebDAV server or in a private GitHub repository; type cloud to restore it on another PC

notes.zh: 填好 WebDAV 或 GitHub 后，卡片上有一行状态和“测试连接”按钮（#495，要 Win顺 0.46.0 或更新）：点一下只读取云端的备份列表、不上传，连上了显示“连接正常”，连不上直接写明原因（地址不对、密码错、仓库不是私有等）。权限不变。
notes.en: Once WebDAV or GitHub is filled in, the card has a status line and a Test connection button (#495, WinShun 0.46.0 or later): it only lists the backups in the cloud, uploading nothing, and says 连接正常 or why it failed (a wrong address or password, a repository that is not private). Permissions unchanged.
